newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds real return 6.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds real return 6.22 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 99.39759 UDIs and a real return of 6.22 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,022-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.42 percent and a price of 102.75852 UDIs.
Demand this week was 1.57 billion billion UDIs for the 1,092 UDI bonds compared to 500 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.14.
Two weeks ago demand was 1,400 million UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.80
For the first time 1,820-day UDI bonds were on offer by Banco de Mexico.
They were assigned at a price of 98.73857 UDIs and real return of 6.30 percent.
Demand this week was 1.61 billion UDIs for the 1,820 day UDI bonds compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 6.44.
